string.name: STR_MATTER_PROC_BLEED_R2_50A_DESC

string.name: STR_EVENT_FOOD_OLYMPICS_01_DESC
string.body: A tasty loaf of grains, fruit, nuts, and chocolate to power you through difficult challenges.\nEating it increases [%e1.StatUp.StatName], [%e1.StatUp.StatName2], [%e2.StatUp.StatName], and [%e2.StatUp.StatName2] by [%e1.StatUp.Value], [%e1.StatUp.Value2], [%e2.StatUp.Value], and [%e2.StatUp.Value2] points respectively for [%e1.StatUp.RemainTime].

string.name: STR_EVENT_FOOD_OLYMPICS_02_DESC
string.body: An energy drink that boosts stamina.\n Drinking it increases [%e1.StatUp.StatName] by [%e1.StatUp.Value], [%e1.StatUp.StatName2] by [%e1.StatUp.Value2], [%e2.StatUp.StatName] by [%e2.StatUp.Value], and [%e2.StatUp.StatName2] by [%e2.StatUp.Value2] points for [%e1.StatUp.RemainTime].

string.body: This box contains either Dye: True White, or Dye: True Black,, or a complete 8-piece Rainbow Dye Pack II.\nDouble-click (or right-click) it to get ready for your big event!

string.body: This jewel signifies gravity.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.body: This jewel signifies wrath.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_TIAMATCRYSTAL_C_01_DESC
string.body: This jewel signifies petrification.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_SHULACKPLANE_C_01_DESC
string.body: A replica of a Steam Tachysphere.\nIt is based on the design of an actual Steam Tachysphere, however, the joints' functions are limited, preventing some degrees of movement.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_STIGMAL_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a stigma stone replica.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_BURNER_C_01_DESC
string.body: This beautiful crystal ball shimmers with Aether.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DRADGIONL_C_01_DESC
string.body: A miniature replica of the latest Dredgion.\nYou can make out a Gravity Controller, the Dredgion Core, and even a Photon Cannon. With such remarkable detail, it wouldn't be all that surprising to find miniature Balaur working away inside.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_ODRECEIVER_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is an Obelisk inside a transparent cube, an angular accent piece.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_PEARL_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a clam containing beautiful pearls.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_COMAD_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Komad model that reminds you of your exploits within Taloc's Hollow.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_CANDYBASKET_C_01_DESC
string.body: This lovely basket contains liquor, fruit, and mushrooms.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_PORTALTRIGGER_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a replica of the Krall's guardian stone.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_STIGMAD_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a stigma replica.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DRADGIOND_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A miniature replica of the latest Dredgion.\nYou can make out a Gravity Controller, the Dredgion Core, and even a Photon Cannon. With such remarkable detail, it wouldn't be all that surprising to find miniature Balaur working away inside.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_ADMADOLL_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A little teddy bear that originally belonged to Seiren Ntuamu.\nSadly, Princess Karemiwen took everything from Ntuamu, including Lannok's love, and the bear.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_TELEPORTERRUG_C_01_DESC
string.body: A rug with the magic ward of movement pattern on it.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_MANDURI_LIGHT_C_01_DESC
string.body: This lighting is made of the branches from which condor eggs dangle.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_FLAG_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is an insignia for winning a war.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DRAGON_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a Tahabata replica.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_RUDRA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Stormwing statuette.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_RAKSHA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Raksha statuette.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_ELEMENTALKING_C_01_DESC
string.body: A model of the terrible Yamennes, the mightiest creature within the Abyssal Splinter.\nEven though the model is a fraction of Yamennes' size, the sculptor still managed to convey the beast's unbridled fury.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_KRALLDRUM_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is Chieftain Kraka's drum.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_TESINON_C_01_DESC
string.body: A model of the Fourth Weapon, Dorhan.\nIt is staring at you as if it were about to eat you alive.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DAILYNPCSL_C_01_DESC
string.body: A lovely statue of the Arachne Sisters.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_COREBATTERY_C_01_DESC
string.body: An Elemental Core created from the Powers of the Four Spirits.\nIt is a valuable item that shows the powers of the purified spirit that Theobomos created.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_PORGUSS_C_01_DESC
string.body: This replica celebrates the return of Poppy, [%dic:STR_DIC_LA159]'s pet Porgus.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_ATREIA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A replica of all Atreia.\nThe level of detail is quite remarkable, and can be used for strategic planning if needed.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_OD_BOMB_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a non-lethal replica of an Aether bomb.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_UNDEADLIGHT_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A statue of the Betrayer Villaire.\nVillaire was once a member of the Red Sky Legion, but abandoned his comrades after being tempted by material things.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_DAILYNPCSD_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A handsome statue of the Marchutan Brothers.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.body: A framed commendation given by the Brigade General.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_LF1PAINTING_C_01_DESC
string.body: An oil painting depicting the beautiful Cliona Lake.\nThe bright and warm strokes adds luster to the peaceful scenes, and reminds you of your life before your ascension.

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_DRAGONSCROLL_C_01_DESC
string.body: It is a dragon scroll of good fortune.\nIt can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_C_01_DESC
string.body: A stunning painting of a Shugo.\nThe gentle smile and slightly turned face, combined with dark and deep eyes gives the subject of the painting a real sense of identity.

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_DF2CITATION_C_01_DESC
string.body: A framed commendation given by the Brigade General.\nIt can be used as an interior decoration.

string.name: STR_DECE_ACHIEVE_DF1PAINTING_C_01_DESC
string.body: An oil painting depicting Lake Tunapre.\nThe dark and cold colours give the piece a strange, dreamlike feel. It's a shame that the creator's identity is unknown.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_MIRROR_C_01_DESC
string.body: A mirror that feels--even looks--cold.\nKromede, the lady of sad fortune, actually used this mirror in the great Fire Temple.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_COFFIN_C_01_DESC
string.body: An accessory modeled after the coffin in Beshmundir Temple.\nYou feel a sense of foreboding around it, and the rattling sound occasionally heard inside it is enough to raise your hairs.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGONSCROLL_03
string.body: [Souvenir] Scroll Frame made of Fall Trees

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_ATREIA_01_DESC
string.body: It is an Atreia piece containing the scent of spring.\nObtainable only in spring.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_ATREIA_02_DESC
string.body: It is an Atreia piece containing the scent of summer.\nObtainable only in summer.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_ATREIA_03_DESC
string.body: It is an Atreia piece containing the scent of fall.\nObtainable only in fall.\nWhen the remainder of the pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_ATREIA_04_DESC
string.body: It is an Atreia piece containing the scent of winter.\nObtainable only in winter.\nWhen the remainder of the pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGONSCROLL_01_DESC
string.body: This scroll piece vividly displays the blazing sparks of Raksha.\nObtainable only in spring.\nWhen the remainder of the pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGONSCROLL_02_DESC
string.body: This scroll piece describes Tahabata's roar in great detail.\nObtainable only in summer.\nWhen the remainder of the pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGONSCROLL_03_DESC
string.body: This special scroll frame can hold the drawings of the Balaur, and forms part of a set.\nObtainable only in fall.\nWhen the remainder of the pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGONSCROLL_04_DESC
string.body: This scroll piece vividly describes the cold eyes of Stormwing.\nObtainable only in winter.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_01_DESC
string.body: It is a piece of an elaborate portrait of a Shugo.\nObtainable only in spring.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_02_DESC
string.body: It is a bust portrait of a prim Shugo.\nObtainable only in summer.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_03_DESC
string.body: It is a piece of a drawing depicting a Shugo's glimmering earrings in detail.\nObtainable only in fall.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_ASSAMBLY_ACHIEVE_SHUGOPAINTING_04_DESC
string.body: It is a piece of a drawing that beautifully depicts a Shugo's turban.\nObtainable only in winter.\nWhen the remaining pieces are collected to complete the whole work, they can be used for decorating a house.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_FOOD_SWEET_2STATS_01A_DESC
string.body: A tart as sweet as honey.\n[%e1.StatUp.StatName], [%e1.StatUp.StatName2], [%e2.StatUp.StatName], and [%e2.StatUp.StatName2] increase by [%e1.StatUp.Value], [%e1.StatUp.Value2], [%e2.StatUp.Value], and [%e2.StatUp.Value2] points respectively for [%e1.StatUp.RemainTime].

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSL_C_01_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Typhon, president of the Alabaster Order.\nThe words "Pure White Elegance Edition" are etched into the art.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSL_C_02_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Pompo, a Radiant Ops recruiter.\nHis features have been well represented here, and the pose he's pulling off looks very typical of Pompo.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSL_C_03_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Juris Po, captain of the Fortuneers.\nThe model is very accurate, and features his penetrating eyes and wide-brimmed hat.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSL_C_04_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Jiyunia.\nHer laid back attitude has been well represented in the model, mostly through her loosely crossed arms and casual pose. She's every bit as attractive here as in the skin.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSD_D_C_01_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Deryk, registrar of the Field Wardens.\nHis face are hidden behind the brilliant green armour that he wears.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSD_D_C_02_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Viscum, commander of the Blood Crusade.\nA roaring posture to the sky imparts a strong sense of spirited ambitions.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSD_D_C_03_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Tikalanerk, a beautiful member of Charlirunerk's Daemons.\nThis would make a fine decoration for your home.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NEWDAILYNPCSD_D_C_04_DESC
string.body: A sculpture of Petrarca, manager of The Circle.\nPetty burglars like the Ulgorn Raiders would turn tail after coming under Petrarca's murderous gaze.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_ACHIEVE_DRAGON_01_DESC

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_DRAGON_C_01_DESC
string.body: A wall decoration modeled on the great Tahabata.\nThe craftsmanship is so exquisite that it looks ready to spew fire from its mouth any instant.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_RUDRA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A wall decoration modeled on Stormwing, the self-declared sixth Dragon Lord.\nStare at it long enough, and it looks as though it moves before your very eyes.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_RAKSHA_C_01_DESC
string.body: A wall decoration modeled on Raksha's twisted anger.\nRaksha was once powerful enough to challenge Tiamat himself. Sadly, for him, Tiamat was significantly stronger.

string.name: STR_JUNK_DAILYGATHER_SHELL_01_DESC
string.body: Inside the shell, a beautiful pearl awaits.

string.name: STR_JUNK_DAILYGATHER_STONE_01_DESC
string.body: A shining by-product of Aether ore extraction.

string.name: STR_JUNK_DAILYGATHER_PLANT_01_DESC
string.body: A flower that symbolizes the natural cycle. Nepera in Oriel's Green Forest Trail Village is desperately seeking it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron's first-ever work.\nIt demonstrates the aesthetics of self-control and restraint, rather than flamboyant exuberance.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50B_DESC
string.body: The fish that took Liuron half a day to catch.\nIts looks as powerful and as huge as a Balaur soldier, though obviously is a good deal tastier.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50C_DESC
string.body: Makron crafted this decorative item after being inspired by blazing flames.\nIt is not as hot as it looks!

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50D_DESC
string.body: The gently reflecting light is simply exquisite.\nEuron once accidentally dropped a pick on it, but fortunately there wasn't a single scratch on it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50E_DESC
string.body: Sniron used to take scores of these vegetables to snack on in-between meals.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50F_DESC
string.body: It was originally made as a gift for Makron, but Makron flew off the handle because he thought it was a waste of precious ore. It had to be discarded.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50G_DESC
string.body: Kashuron disliked eating vegetables so much that he hid them in a secret place, where they grew larger and larger.\nYou should probably keep these away from children.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50H_DESC
string.body: The pages in the notebook were made by processing several wide leaves.\nThese were used before the days of paper, and are still used where wood is hard to come by.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50I_DESC
string.body: The beautiful flower buds put even the most vigilant of soldiers at ease.\nUnfortunate then, that the stalks can strike out with such deadly force.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_50J_DESC
string.body: A basic musical instrument made by weaving twigs together.\nSkilled musicians can make something tuneful from it, but most find it better used as a basic type of bow.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron thought this brooch took after his look.\nIt's impossibly flamboyant, and Dukiron is totally mesmerized by it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55B_DESC
string.body: Its scales and teeth were so sharp that it can't be caught with a regular fishing line.\nPseron finally caught it using a special fishing line made from vines.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55C_DESC
string.body: Makron made this accessory as he was inspired by the flashing thunderbolt that was falling from dark clouds.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55D_DESC
string.body: Mikaron made this plate by engraving personally-designed patterns and inserting jewels that he crafted.\nHis attention to detail is phenomenal.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55E_DESC
string.body: This vegetable's peel is so tough and hard that not many have the perseverance to get to the fruit inside.\nHowever, Fat Sniron would peel it off with much gusto.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55F_DESC
string.body: Euron's favoured mining pick.\nMakron changed the handle once, though Euron failed to notice any difference.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55G_DESC
string.body: A vegetable that Kashuron dislikes. This one has hardened considerably.\nThe awful smell is excellent at repelling harmful bugs.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55H_DESC
string.body: It is a notebook made from the fruits around Tyron's home.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55I_DESC
string.body: A flower that Pseron cultivated with all her love for Dukiron. \nJust like her heart heads towards Dukiron, this flower grows towards the direction of the Tower of Eternity.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_55J_DESC
string.body: A musical instrument that Hudaron used to play while sitting in his favourite tree.\nIt has only one string but has a beautiful tone to it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron was haunted by an terrible sense of jealousy after completing this brooch.\nIt defied his belief that nothing more beautiful than himself could exist.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60B_DESC
string.body: This is the biggest fish that Liuron has ever caught in his whole life.\nIt was so big that Fat Sniron lost his mind over it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60C_DESC
string.body: An accessory Makron made while mulling over the harmony between fire and water, and other contrasting properties.\nMakron was greatly enlightened once he completed the accessory.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60D_DESC
string.body: A beautiful plate featuring five bold colours.\nYou can hear the gentle rush of the sea when you place your ear next to it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60E_DESC
string.body: A snack that Fat Sniron kept deep inside his cave for he fear someone might take it.\nHe ended up leaving it for so long that it turned too hard to eat.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60F_DESC
string.body: An axe that Euron only used when cutting down the largest trees he could find.\nThough overly heavy, it has a soft and comfortable grip.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60G_DESC
string.body: A toy made by further hardening rotten vegetables. Yuck!

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60H_DESC
string.body: A notebook with pages made from thinly sliced pieces of fruit.\nEven though old, it still smells rather sweet.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60I_DESC
string.body: This flower was wasting away without having to bloom once. But Pseron's dedicated care has given it the life of eternity.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_L_GATHER_WALLDECO_60J_DESC
string.body: An instrument with strings made from flowers and leaves. How strange.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50A_DESC
string.body: Dukiron's first-ever work.\nIt demonstrates the beauty of self-control rather than flamboyance.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50B_DESC
string.body: The fish that took Liuron half a day to catch.\nIts looks as powerful and as huge as a Balaur soldier, though obviously is a good deal tastier.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50C_DESC
string.body: Makron crafted this decorative item after being inspired by blazing flames.\nIt is not as hot as it looks!

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50D_DESC
string.body: The gently reflecting light is simply exquisite.\nEuron once accidentally dropped a pick on it, but fortunately there wasn't a single scratch on it.

string.name: STR_SPECIAL_D_GATHER_WALLDECO_50E_DESC
string.body: Sniron used to take scores of these vegetables to snack on in-between meals.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_BED_55A_DESC
string.body: It is a bed decorated with Queen Klawnickt's visage. How could anyone sleep with that thing staring at them?

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_BED_55B_DESC
string.body: A bed that was modeled after Turatu's features. Even though it looks kinda wet, it's actually really, really comfortable.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_55A_DESC
string.body: A seat modeled on Skuma Silvereye's features.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_55B_DESC
string.body: A seat modeled on Elder Narikiki's features. It's pure comfort, no matter how you lie on it.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_D_55A_DESC
string.body: A seat modeled on Chieftain Ulagu's features. It feels snug and comfortable, though the beak is a bit distracting.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_D_55B_DESC
string.body: A seat modeled on Gravekeeper Basaim's features. The head sculpture is beaming with bluish eyes, radiating an ominous vibe. It should be effective for repelling burglars and thieves.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_BED_60A_DESC
string.body: A bed blessed with the protection of the Spirit of Tranquility. It resonates with a calming warmth.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_BED_60B_DESC
string.body: A stone bed decorated with Daturum's bust. More functional than comfortable, this bed is recommended for any Daevas concerned about their spinal health.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_60A_DESC
string.body: A lighting stand that was remodeled to look like Captain Babelkin's helmet. The words "Made in the Kaichin Engineering Union" are engraved on the inside of the stand.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_SOFA_60B_DESC
string.body: A couch imbued with the raw power of Vanuka the Earthshaker. Creepy!

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_CHAIR_60A_DESC
string.body: A chair that couldn't be more comfortable if it tried.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_CHAIR_60B_DESC
string.body: A chair inspired by the features of Ironjaw Tarapu. As interesting as it looks, it doesn't look all that comfortable.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_RUG_60A_DESC
string.body: A wall-mounted decoration made from the skin of Gabo the Obstinate. It is a flawless, top-quality product with fine fur and a sharp horn.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SPECIAL_COMBINE_RUG_60B_DESC
string.body: A wall-mounted decoration inspired by the features of Insidious Barolf. Scary stuff.

string.name: STR_CHARGE_ITEM_PACK_02_60_DESC
string.body: Conditions eligible items up to Level 2.\nDouble-click on Deep Conditioning and then select the applicable item.

string.name: STR_ACHARGE_ITEM_LEVEL01_60A_DESC
string.body: Adds magic charge up to the maximum allowed for Level 1 when used on an item that can be augmented.\nAfter activating an item for augmentation, double-click (or use the right mouse button) to select an item as the target to be augmented.

string.name: STR_ACHARGE_ITEM_LEVEL02_60A_DESC
string.body: When augmenting an item, the magic used can be allocated up to a level 2 maximum.\nAfter activating an augmented item by double-clicking (or using the right mouse button), you can select an item as the target to be augmented.

string.name: STR_ACHARGE_ITEM_D_LEVEL01_60A_DESC
string.body: Adds magic charge up to the maximum allowed for Level 1 when used on an item that can be augmented.\nAfter activating an item for augmentation, double-click (or use the right mouse button) to select an item as the target to be augmented.

string.name: STR_ACHARGE_ITEM_D_LEVEL02_60A_DESC
string.body: Adds an Augment up to the maximum allowed for Level 2 when used on an item that can be magically charged.\nActivate the Augment item by double-clicking (or right-clicking) it, then select the item you want charged with magic.

string.name: STR_ACHARGE_ITEM_PACK_LEVEL01_60A_DESC
string.body: Enhances all suitable and equipped items using magic power up to level 1.\nActivate the item for augmentation by double-clicking (or right-clicking).

string.name: STR_ACHARGE_ITEM_PACK_LEVEL02_60A_DESC
string.body: Enhances all suitable and equipped items using magic power up to level 2.\nActivate the item for Augmentation by double-clicking (or right-clicking).

string.name: STR_ACHARGE_ITEM_PACK_D_LEVEL01_60A_DESC
string.body: Enhances all suitable and equipped items using magic power up to level 1.\nActivate the item for augmentation by double-clicking (or right-clicking).

string.name: STR_ACHARGE_ITEM_PACK_D_LEVEL02_60A_DESC
string.body: Enhances all suitable and equipped items using magic power up to level 2.\nActivate the item for Augmentation by double-clicking (or right-clicking).

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN01A_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: A Wild Heart headband wrapped and ready for giving.\nDouble-click to obtain a heart headband and change your look for a day, 7 days, or forever.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN01A_BOX_02_DESC
string.body: This basket seems to contain sweet chocolates.\nDouble-click to obtain a weapon refining stone, armour refining stone, or accessory refining stone.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN01A_BOX_03_DESC
string.body: This basket appears to contain sweet candies.\nDouble-click to obtain a godstone, enchantment stone, manastone, or another useful item.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN01B_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: A sweet little gift to share or keep.\nDouble-click to obtain a very tiny gift.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN03A_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: This gift box contains a traditional eastern costume.\nDouble-click to obtain a traditional costume and change your look for a day, 7 days, 30 days, or forever.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN03A_BOX_02_DESC
string.body: A box containing a special seasonal dye.\nDouble-click to obtain a dye and change your look for a day, 7 days, or 15 days.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN03A_BOX_03_DESC
string.body: This seems to be a box of tasty seasonal snacks, but please think twice before eating them.\nDouble-click to obtain a weapon refining stone, armour refining stone, accessory refining stone, or godstone.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN03B_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: A lovely little gift to share or keep.\nDouble-click to obtain a very tiny gift.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN04A_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: This box holds a special Wonderland costume item.\nDouble-click to obtain one of the Wonderland waistcoats, shoes, or gloves to change your look for a day or 7 days.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN04A_BOX_02_DESC
string.body: A hat box from Wonderland and beyond.\nDouble-click to obtain one of the hats or hairpins that change your look for 7 days, 30 days, or forever.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN04A_BOX_03_DESC
string.body: A box of dye transported from Wonderland.\nDouble-click to obtain one of the dyes that change your look for a day, 7 days, or 15 days.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN04B_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: A small gift transported from Wonderland.\nDouble-click to obtain a very tiny gift.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN05A_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: A box containing a costume celebrating the Solorius.\nDouble-click to obtain one of the Solorius costumes to change your look for a day, 7 days, 30 days, or forever.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN05A_BOX_02_DESC
string.body: A box containing a hat celebrating the Solorius.\nDouble-click to obtain one of the Solorius hats to change your look for a day, 7 days, 30 days, or forever.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN05A_BOX_03_DESC
string.body: This cheery stocking contains candy celebrating the Solorius.\nDouble-click to obtain one of the transformation candies.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN05B_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: A gift bag containing a souvenir from the Solorius.\nDouble-click to obtain a very tiny gift.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_CASH_COIN_AU_09_DESC

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_COIN_AU_14_DESC
string.body: A token gained from various Millenium Festival events. Take them to a <Festival Gift Giver> for a free item.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_BOHEMIAN_XBOOST_02_DESC
string.body: You gain 20%% additional XP from gathering, crafting, or hunting creatures while Wanderer's Night is active.\nThe effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_WORLD_EVT_HW_01_DESC
string.body: This flowerpot gives you a housewarming gift that keeps on giving.\nAttend to it with care and the tree will give you a present. Looking after it requires morning dew.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_WORLD_EVT_HW_02_DESC
string.body: This flowerpot gives you a housewarming gift that keeps on giving.\nAttend to it with care and the tree will give you a present. Looking after it requires morning dew.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_COUPON_CUSTOMIZE_01_60M_DESC
string.body: You can change your face and body shape.\nElyos can change appearance by going to Maenia in the Fine Boutique in Sanctum, and Asmodians can visit Himingleva in the Fine Boutique in Pandaemonium to change their appearance.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_COUPON_SEX_EXCHANGE_01_60M_DESC
string.body: You can change your gender as well as your face and body shape.\nElyos can change gender by going to Euripides in a tavern in the Outer Dock, and Asmodians can visit Yotunmord in the back alleys of the Pandaemonium Plaza to change their gender.

string.name: WORLD_WRAP_REFILL_CUSTOMIZE_1DAY_DESC
string.body: Enables you to generate a plastic surgery ticket that changes your face and body shape.\nYou can use it for a day.

string.name: WORLD_WRAP_REFILL_CUSTOMIZE_3DAY_DESC
string.body: Enables you to generate a plastic surgery ticket that changes your face and body shape.\nUsable for 3 days.

string.name: WORLD_WRAP_REFILL_SEX_EXCHANGE_1DAY_DESC
string.body: Enables you to generate a gender switch ticket that changes your gender and appearance.\nYou can use it for a day.

string.name: WORLD_WRAP_REFILL_SEX_EXCHANGE_3DAY_DESC
string.body: Enables you to generate a gender switch ticket that changes your gender and appearance.\nUsable for 3 days.

string.name: STR_WRAP_MEDAL_04A_DESC
string.body: Contains a Mithril Medal.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_EXTEND_WAREHOUSE_03_DESC
string.body: This card expands your cube, giving you the first, the second or the third additional row. You can only use a maximum of three of these items per character.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_FOOD_dpheal_50A_DESC
string.body: An acorn jelly that Shugos find quite tasty.\nIt restores 4,000 DP points.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_FOOD_R_2STATS_S_50I_DESC
string.body: This is a Shugo's favourite chocolate, sweet with a hint of heat.\n[%e1.StatUp.StatName] and [%e2.StatUp.StatName] increase by [%e1.StatUp.Value] and [%e2.StatUp.Value] points respectively for [%e1.StatUp.RemainTime].

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_FOOD_R_2STATS_S_50J_DESC
string.body: A tasty porridge made from acorns.\n[%e2.StatUp.StatName] and [%e3.StatUp.StatName] increase by [%e2.StatUp.Value] and [%e3.StatUp.Value] points respectively for [%e2.StatUp.RemainTime]. There is a slight chance of being poisoned by the acorns!

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_23A
string.body: [Favourable Luck] Face of a Matchless Warrior

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_02B
string.body: [Excellent Luck] Face of Flowers Added to Embroidery

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_03B

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_04B
string.body: [Excellent Luck] Face of Serving Two Ends

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_01A_DESC
string.body: You can fly even if you've only got one wing. Have faith and dedicate yourself to everything you do.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_02A_DESC
string.body: You feel as though you could obtain Aether from the very air around you. Only committed efforts breed hope.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_03A_DESC
string.body: You have lots of issues and mistakes to correct, but a helper will appear to get you out of trouble.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_04A_DESC
string.body: Consider how the mother Brax responds to the cries of her young Braxie. You have a face of preordained promise.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_05A_DESC
string.body: Stop your worries over slow growth. The only thing that should concern you is if you've stopped moving at all.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while the charm remains active.\nThis effect expires after 30 minutes, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_06A_DESC
string.body: You may have anxieties on the outside, but feel pleasant on the inside. Rest yourself for comfort and wellbeing.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_07A_DESC
string.body: The grass lies as the wind blows. Remain committed to your party leader and you'll be compensated in more ways than one.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_08A_DESC
string.body: Consider how Kirrin cross water. You can't make your way across water without your tail getting wet.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_09A_DESC
string.body: You change your equipment according to the changing season, according to the changing needs of your situation. Everything thus falls into place.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_10A_DESC
string.body: As the pond water spreads to plants and trees, trust advances through Porgus and Ribbit. It is beneficial for you to cross the biggest rivers, the toughest challenges. Only then will disasters and difficulties be dissipated.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_11A_DESC
string.body: While stars appear in broad daylight, they retreat so far from the sun that they cannot be seen. When the sun appears under water, it is difficult to get it to brighten up the outlook of your ongoing trials.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_12A_DESC
string.body: The pot looks a Kobold, making them match each other perfectly. Cooking raw food requires changes in the process and creates changes in chemistry. Only when completed, the scent and taste you desire will be obtained.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_13A_DESC
string.body: Daru changes to become Kirrin. You should mend old things and adopt new things. You cannot pour new wine into an old, dirty skin.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_14A_DESC
string.body: An auspicious bird is flying high, promising something better for you. A small seed will sprout slowly, so slowly, into a mighty tree.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_15A_DESC
string.body: It wasn't the item you desired, but perhaps it desired you. Nothing was ever guaranteed, so making the best of your opportunities leads you to something more.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_16A_DESC
string.body: It is as easy as slashing through Spriggs with a Master Orichalcum Dagger. It may look like a loss at first, but will turn out to be a blessing in disguise later on.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_17A_DESC
string.body: The male Brax leans against the fence, rather than carrying its own weight. It is not going to be advantageous for you, so stop seeking support, because whatever help you gain will be minor, indeed.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_18A_DESC
string.body: A flower is about to bloom on a winter tree. Even if you firmly discipline your mind and move forward, you should consider yourself lucky if only half of what you have wished for becomes realised.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_19A_DESC
string.body: The ground rumbles, a Sparkle appears and strikes its wings together. Everything under the sun flows to you so easily, and nothing can go wrong at this point.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_20A_DESC
string.body: A wolf may pass easily among docile sheep. Beware evil intent disguised by beauty. If you keep your heart pure, everything will fall into place.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_21A_DESC
string.body: As fishes seek calm pools in which to play, you get to share an item with your closest Daeva. Everything you desire will be yours. How can you not like everything?\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_22A_DESC
string.body: Although you acquired a Hero item, it doesn't belong to your class. Its greater force instead drags you down, slowing your reactions. If you keep your heart pure and stay focused on who you are, everything will fall into place.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_23A_DESC
string.body: You attack with the strength of several Daeva at once. The number of foes won't be a problem for you. Petty minds should avoid using this.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_24A_DESC
string.body: You continue to pursue Drakie, but you really need to find Daru. Chasing a habit prevents you from seeking something better.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 10%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_01B_DESC
string.body: A fair wind is blowing in your direction, everything starts to prosper, and your honourable reputation becomes even more elevated.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while the charm remains active.\nThis effect expires after 30 minutes, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_02B_DESC
string.body: A path of open wind and water droplets form a bridge across the heavens. If you have a destination to reach, it is definitely an auspicious sign.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_03B_DESC
string.body: Swords are returned to their sheaths in respect, and you are presented to an Empyrean Lord. Nothing can hinder you do because all will be well.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while the charm remains active.\nThis effect expires after 30 minutes, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_04B_DESC
string.body: Imagine Stormwing and Tahabata fighting each other in front of your eyes. Even the youngest Daeva will achieve two goals in a single attempt.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WORLD_PET_DRBOOST_05B_DESC
string.body: You ride on flooding river water to traverse hundreds of miles in a heartbeat. Even the smallest wing will fly you to your goal.\nThe chance of obtaining items from hunting creatures increases by 20%% while this effect is active.\nThis effect expires after 1 hour, and you cannot use it again for 10 hours.

string.name: STR_WRAP_PETREWARD_LITTLESHUGOM_FORTUNE_01A_DESC
string.body: Lukeshunerk's gift package, just for you.\nDouble-click (or right-click) it to use it.

string.name: STR_WRAP_PETREWARD_LITTLESHUGOM_FORTUNE_02A_DESC
string.body: Lukeshunerk's emergency supplies. If this had been a real emergency, Lukeshunerk would make a loud, high-pitched sound until dismissed.\nDouble-click (or right-click) it to use them.

string.name: STR_WRAP_PETREWARD_LITTLESHUGOM_FORTUNE_03A_DESC
string.body: A chest containing Lukeshunerk's divination.\nDouble-click (or right-click) it to use it.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_COIN_AU_CCU_CHINA_01_DESC
string.body: A valuable card that brings good fortune. Bring it to Langlang and Mingming in a major city.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN201A_BOX_01_DESC
string.body: A jade crate inscribed with a white tiger.\nDouble-click (or right-click) it to discover an item of good fortune.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN201A_BOX_02_DESC
string.body: A silver crate inscribed with a blue dragon.\nDouble-click (or right-click) it to discover an item of good fortune.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HCOIN201A_BOX_03_DESC
string.body: A golden crate inscribed with a fenghuang.\nDouble-click (or right-click) it to discover an item of good fortune.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_CHINA_01A_DESC
string.body: A richly glowing golden essence.\nA mainland craftsman's attention to detail shines in this handiwork.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_WORLD_EVENT_MATERIAL_CHINA_02A_DESC
string.body: A shimmering red roll of silk cloth.\nUsed in many traditional eastern costumes, this silk is the highest grade material available.

string.name: STR_POSTMAILBOX_SALE_01_DESC
string.body: A mailbox that can be added to your garden décor.

string.body: Show your purity of spirit with this good luck accessory.\nWhen you transfer the appearance of this item to another item through an appearance modifier, the changed appearance remains for 30 days.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_FIRECRACKER_01_DESC

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_HAPPY_BOX_ACCESSORY_01A_DESC
string.body: A lucky accessory in a lovely box.\nDouble-click (or right-click) it to discover either the Good Luck Circlet or the Lucky Angel Ring.

string.name: STR_TEST_RB_TORSO_50A_DESC
string.body: An item that comes with 100 HP as a bonus option, but with -327 HP and 100 MP as a random option, ultimately coming down to 100 MP.

string.body: A Guestbloom obtained from Raksang.\nWhen well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a pair of boots or gloves from the legendary Raksha Legionary.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_IDYUN_GLOVESHOES_01_DESC
string.body: A Guestbloom obtained from the Rentus Base.\nWhen well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a pair of boots or gloves from the Resistance Army.

string.name: STR_ITEM_OWNERTREE_TREASURE_04D_01_DESC
string.body: Lesser Ancient Icon Hearthbloom.\nHouse owners of level 50 and lower can obtain Lesser Ancient Icons once per day when by using their Hearthbloom Fertilizers. House owners of level 51 and above are not eligible for a reward.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_IDCORE_COSTUME_01_DESC
string.body: An Abyssal Plate Costume Guestbloom.\nWhen well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a Forgotten Abyss Plate Costume or, rarely, a Forgotten Abyss Plate Costume Guestbloom.

string.name: STR_ITEM_VISITORTREE_FANATIC01_COSTUME_01_DESC
string.body: A Dragonbound Leather Costume Guestbloom.\nWhen well maintained, often with Guestbloom Fertilizers, this Guestbloom can give you a Dragonbound Leather Costume, rarely, a Dragonbound Leather Costume Guestbloom.

string.name: STR_ITEM_CP_WORLD_HLWN_INFLOOR_001_DESC
string.body: Item that can be used as flooring.\nSuitable for all homes.

string.name: STR_ITEM_WORLD_SOFA_XMAS_DESC
string.body: Sofa with red cushions that adds to the atmosphere of the Solorius Festival.

string.name: STR_ITEM_WORLD_SOFA_HLWN_DESC
string.body: An unusual looking sofa for the Halloween festival.

string.name: STR_ITEM_WORLD_OWNERPOT_XMAS_DESC
string.body: A Solorius Hearthbloom.\nIf the homeowner tends to the hearthbloom once a day, they receive a gift.\nThey must tend to it for 6 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_WORLD_OWNERPOT_HLWN_DESC
string.body: A Halloween flower pot.\nIf the homeowner tends to the tree once a day, they receive a gift.\nThey must tend to it for 6 days.

string.name: STR_WORLD_IVBOX_TYPEA_XMAS_DESC
string.body: A beautifully decorated cabinet.\nIt can contain other items and is thus suitable for storage.

string.name: STR_WORLD_IVBOX_TYPEA_HLWN_DESC
string.body: A spooky decorated cabinet.\nIt can contain other items and is thus suitable for storage.

string.name: STR_ITEM_WORLD_CHAIR_XMAS_DESC
string.body: A chair that contributes to the atmosphere of the Solorius Festival.

string.name: STR_ITEM_WORLD_CHAIR_HLWM_DESC
string.body: A chair that contributes to the spooky atmosphere of Halloween.

string.name: STR_WORLD_BED_XMAS_DESC
string.body: A comfortable bed for the Solorius Festival.

string.name: STR_WORLD_LIGHT_STAND_HLWN_DESC
string.body: Lighting that fits the sinister atmosphere of Halloween perfectly.

string.name: STR_WORLD_LIGHT_TABLE_HLWN_DESC
string.body: The ideal lighting for a creepy Halloweeen.

string.name: STR_WORLD_IVBOX_TYPEB_HLWN_DESC
string.body: Halloween Tree Decoration Cabinet.\nIt can contain other items and is thus suitable for storage.

string.name: STR_WORLD_SHELF_HLWN_DESC

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_ITEM_VP_RECOVERY_50_DESC
string.body: A precious tea which recovers 50%% Energy of Repose.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_BASARTI_C_01
string.body: [Souvenir] Wall decoration made from Vasharti's Gauntlets

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NARIKIKI_C_01
string.body: [Souvenir] Jewellery from the Narikiki Cat Weapon

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_BASARTI_C_01_DESC
string.body: A wall decoration made from the Brigade General Vasharti's Gauntlets.\nIt gives an impression of the stateliness of Balaur armour.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_TIAMATDRAGON_C_01_DESC
string.body: A figurine in the image of Tiamat.\nTiamat was the last of the five Dragon Lords to rise.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_NARIKIKI_C_01_DESC
string.body: Narikiki's Cat Weapon.\nThis item was made in the shape of the cat weapon carried by Narikiki in the Rokoros Village.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_WLLAUOO_C_01_DESC
string.body: Chieftain Ulagus' Mask.\nThe fantastic, spiky hair makes it look like it is alive.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_TIAMATMAGE_C_01_DESC
string.body: A figurine in the image of Tiamat.\nYou feel its gaze upon you.

string.name: STR_DECO_ACHIEVE_NEPILIMHAMMER_C_01_DESC
string.body: That is the all-powerful Debarim hammer.\nYou can feel the power of the minerals processed within it.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_HETGELM_C_01_DESC
string.body: A model of a Hetgolem.\nA dainty-looking little robot.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_GARNON_C_01_DESC
string.body: A model of Garnon.\nIt provides a good impression of Garnon's beautiful appearance, her slim figure and her blonde hair.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_KAISINEL_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Kaisinel figurine.\nHe is the Lord of Illusion and guardian spirit of Summoners and Sorcerers.\nThe figurine embodies mercy and determination in equal measure.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_MARKOOTAN_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Lord Marchutan figurine.\nHe is the Lord of Destiny and patron of Clerics and Chanters. He is a close friend of Tower Protectress Siel and enemies with Zikel, the Lord of Destruction.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_PORGUSS_C_02_DESC
string.body: A figurine made of delicious roasted Poppy.\nThis item spreads around a pleasant, appetising odour.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_SHELLIZARDNAMED_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Behemoth figurine.\nThis souvenir provides an impression of what the hard skin of the Behemoth is like.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_CONDOR_C_01_DESC
string.body: A King Consierd figurine.\nThe soft black feathers look like high-quality silk.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_ABITAS_C_01_DESC
string.body: A Magical Ativas Crystalline figurine.\nIt looks like a beautiful, shiny crystal.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_TATAR_C_01_DESC
string.body: A model of the Golden Tatar.\nHe's a strong creature and said to originaklly have been a normal Gurriki that was mutated.

string.name: STR_FIGURE_ACHIEVE_PLETOOS_C_01_DESC
string.body: A model of the Unfinished Pletus.\nYou can admire the magnificent, golden appearance of the figurine.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_SCROLL_Devas_Day_L_DESC

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_SCROLL_Devas_Day_D_DESC

string.body: A burning candle.\nIf you use it with the cake on Daeva Day, the XP of all Daevas in the vicinity will triple.

string.body: You receive Holy Candle Energy.\nIf you use it with the festival cake on Daeva Day, you and all Daevas in the vicinity will immediately recover 2000 DP points. Your attack speed increases by 10%% and your activation time for magic skills decreases by 10%% while in this status.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_COIN_DEVASDAY_01_DESC
string.body: Brightly shining Aether Glow.\nTake it to <Aether Glow Trader>, Happolia or Verdine, in Sanctum or Pandaemonium straight away.\nThere, you can exchange it for a candle that you can use with the festive cake for Daeva Day.

string.name: STR_WORLD_EVENT_COIN_DEVASDAY_02_DESC
string.body: A crystal from Lord Israphel.\nTake it to <Merchant for Lords' Crystals> Lupoise in Sanctum or Clantia in Pandaemonium and they will give you a gift for it right away.

It carries a bag with 18 slots.

string.name: STR_VISITORTREE_MATERIAL_N_E_60A_DESC
string.body: Sacred Drenium Guestbloom.\nYou can receive 1 sacred Drenium Crystal if the Guestbloom is taken good care of. If the homeowner receives the crystal, there is a slight chance of obtaining a design for noble weapons. Guestbloom fertiliser is required for proper cultivation.

string.name: STR_VISITORTREE_MATERIAL_N_E_60C_DESC

string.name: STR_EVENT_SCROLL_START_KIT_01C_3DAY_DESC

string.name: STR_TEST_AP_EXTRACTION_01_DESC
string.body: If you extract an item with it, you could receive 20%% of its value in Abyss points.\nActivate the tool by double-clicking (or right-clicking) and then select the item to be extracted.\nCan only be used with regular weapons up to level 40.

string.body: If you extract an item with it, you could receive 50%% of its value in Abyss points.\nActivate the tool by double-clicking (or right-clicking) and then select the item to be extracted.\nCan only be used with heroic armour up to level 40.

string.name: STR_world_add_social_MAID_OMELETTE_30day_desc
string.body: You can use this to learn the emote <Serve Omelette>.\nThis emote can be used for 30 days.

string.name: STR_world_add_social_MAID_SWEEPING_30day_desc
string.body: You can use this to learn the emote <Sweep Floor>.\nThis emote can be used for 30 days.

string.name: STR_world_add_social_DIVING_01A_30day_desc
string.body: You can use this to learn the emote <Dive>.\nThis emote can be used for 30 days.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_INST_01_COIN_01_S3
string.body: Tail of the Imperial Tomb Faerie

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_INST_01_COIN_01_S4
string.body: Horn of the Imperial Tomb Faerie

string.body: Wings of the Imperial Tomb Faerie

string.body: Heart of the Imperial Tomb Faerie

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_INST_01_COIN_01_DESC_S2
string.body: A bag of assorted insignias.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_INST_01_COIN_01_DESC_S3
string.body: The Tail of an Imperial Tomb Faerie, which holds a mysterious power.\nDouble-click to receive 1 coin, or, if luck is with you, a Faerie Horn.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_INST_01_COIN_01_DESC_S4
string.body: The Horn of an Imperial Tomb Faerie, which holds a magical power.\nDouble-click to receive 1 coin, or, if luck is with you, a Faerie Wing.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_INST_01_COIN_01_DESC_S5
string.body: The Wing of an Imperial Tomb Faerie, which holds a magical power.\nDouble-click to receive 1 coin, or, if luck is with you, a Faerie Heart.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_INST_01_COIN_01_DESC_S6
string.body: The Heart of an Imperial Tomb Faerie, which holds a sacred power.\nDouble-click to receive lots of coins.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_INST_01_COIN_01_S7
string.body: Bag containing a Treasure Map Piece

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_INST_01_COIN_01_S8
string.body: Bag containing a Treasure Map Piece

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_INST_01_COIN_01_DESC_S7
string.body: Contains pieces of the Empire's Treasure Map, collected by grave robbers.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_EVENT_INST_01_COIN_01_DESC_S8
string.body: Contains a piece of the Treasure Map to the Imperial Tomb, collected by the Shugo priest.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_TEST_POLISH_ENCHANT_1_DESC
string.body: There is a 50%, 20% and 30% chance respectively of Wrath Reduction 100%, Wrath Increase 100% and Wrath Reduction 50% being applied.

string.name: STR_TEST_POLISH_ENCHANT_2_DESC
string.body: There is a 100% chance of 347 HP and 100 MP being used.

string.name: STR_TEST_POLISH_ENCHANT_3_DESC
string.body: 10% chance of an arbitrary HP value between 100 and 109 being used.

string.name: STR_TEST_POLISH_ENCHANT_4_DESC
string.body: 100% chance that you will receive eight skills at once.

string.name: STR_TEST_POLISH_ENCHANT_5_DESC
string.body: 20% chance of an arbitrary attack value between 1 and 5 being used.

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_SCROLL_INIT_COOLT_IDDF2Flying_Event01_S2

string.name: STR_WORLD_CASH_SCROLL_INIT_COOLT_IDDF2Flying_Event01_S2_DESC

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_01_DESC
string.body: An Elyos will receive a bundle of supplies and an Asmodian will receive crafting materials.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_02_DESC
string.body: A Sorcerer will receive crafting materials, a Summoner will receive a Mace and a Staff.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_03_DESC
string.body: You will receive a Cleric weapon from Level 1 to 39, Assassin's Spaulders from level 40 to 50 and Templar Gloves from Level 50 to 60.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_04_DESC
string.body: An Elyos Gladiator / Templar will receive a Cleric's weapon, an Asmodian Hunter / Assassin will receive a bundle of supplies.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_05_DESC
string.body: An level 1 to 39 Elyos will receive a bundle of supplies, a level 40 to 50 Asmodian will receive crafting materials.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_06_DESC
string.body: A level 1 to 39 Gladiator / Templar will receive a classification item, a levels 40 to 50 Assassin / Hunter will receive a level 55 Cleric's weapon.

string.name: STR_TEST_SELECT_DISASSEMBLY_ITEM_07_DESC
string.body: A level 1 to 39 Elyos Hunter / Assassin will receive a bundle of supplies, a level 40 to 50 Asmodian Gladiator / Templar will receive Assassin's Spaulders.

string.name: STR_ITEM_ALL_TITLE_256_DESC
string.body:
Lets you acquire the <Katalam's Hope> title.
This title increases your Crit Strike by 8 points, your Resist Magic by 15 points and your movement speed by 4%%.
Valid for 7 days.
Silverine Limited used to issue this title, but has since vanished without a trace.

string.name: STR_ITEM_ALL_TITLE_257_DESC
string.body: Lets you acquire the <Katalam's Light> title.\nThis title increases your Crit Strike by 8 points, your Magic Resistance by 15 points and your Movement Speed by 4%%.\nSilverine Limited used to issue this title, but has since vanished without a trace.

string.name: STR_ITEM_ALL_TITLE_258_DESC
string.body:
Lets you acquire the <Guardian of the Green Forest> title.
This title increases your Crit Spell by 5 points, your Magic Suppression by 21 points and your Movement Speed by 4%%.
Valid for 7 days.
The Green Hat Alliance used to issue this title, but they have since vanished without a trace.

string.name: STR_ITEM_ALL_TITLE_259_DESC
string.body: Lets you acquire the <Friend of Nature> title.\nThis title increases your Crit Spell by 5 points, your Magic Suppression by 21 points and your Movement Speed by 4%%.\nThe Green Hat Alliance used to issue this title, but they have since vanished without a trace.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LDF5_UNDER02_QUEST_16982A_DESC
string.body: A valuable and ancient legacy, which seems to have something to do with the uses of Idgel. Its content is difficult to fully understand, as it was written in the language of the Rune.\nIf you are an Elyos at level 65 or higher, you can double-click it to receive a quest.

string.name: STR_SOULSTONE_RESURRECT_OTHER_10_TEST_DESC
string.body: Although this is an item for resurrecting other players, it should be checked whether this item can be used instantly, as well as the item for self-resurrection.\nTests for the option of self-resurrection (actually it is only possible to resurrect other players).

string.name: STR_SOULSTONE_RESURRECT_SELF_TEST2_DESC

string.name: STR_IDF5_TD_WAR_BOOM_01
string.body: Flash Grenade with large effect radius

string.name: STR_IDF5_TD_WAR_BOOM_01_DESC
string.body: Deals [%e1.SpellATK_Instant.FixDamage] points fire damage to a target at a distance of up to [%First_Target_Valid_Distance]m away and to six other opponents within a 15m radius around the target. The opponents are stunned for [%e2.Stun.RemainTime].\nThe grenade can only be used once.

string.name: STR_IDF5_TD_WAR_BOOM_02_DESC
string.body: Deals [%e1.SpellATK_Instant.FixDamage] points fire damage to a target at a distance of up to [%First_Target_Valid_Distance]m away and to six other opponents within a 15m radius around the target. Causes [%e1.SpellATK_Instant.AddDamage] additional points damage if the target is a Fortress Gate. If the target is a tank, there is the chance that the occupants may be thrown out of the tank.\nThe projectile cannot be re-used.

string.name: STR_IDF5_TD_WAR_TANKKEY_01_DESC
string.body: This fuel is needed to operate the following siege weapons on the Steel Wall Bastion battlefield: Flame Tank, Siege Tank, Artillery and Field Artillery.\nFuel is consumed when you get in.

string.name: STR_IDF5_TD_WAR_FORTRESS_COMPONENT_01_DESC
string.body: A shell required for using skills after you enter one of the following Siege Weapons on the Battlefield of the Steel Wall Bastion: Flame Tank, Siege Tank, Artillery or Field Artillery.\nShells will be used for the following skills: Fire Cannon and Flame Jet (Flame Tank), Shield (Siege Tank), Bombardment and Widespread Bombardment (Artillery) as well as Bombardment and Shock Cannon (Field Artillery).\nNo cannonballs will be used with the skill Vortex Collision of the Siege Tank.
